A few more fixes for keyboards and screen readers, and the rest of Transforms off the graphics card.

## Fixed

- Zooming or stretching the picture no longer goes through the graphics card either. A card busy with something else can't slow every frame down anymore.
- Hovering over an open dropdown moves its highlight. Before, the keyboard highlight and the mouse could point at two different items.
- The phone dropdown says "Pick a phone" when there are phones but none is picked, instead of showing nothing.
- The Settings sidebar scrolls when the window is short, so every page can be reached.
- Screen readers read each switch's name once, not twice.
- Screen readers no longer read out the hidden words that Settings search uses to find things.
